confirmed_code_cause.cause: GitHub Contents API base64 response contains line-wrap whitespace; strict b64decode(validate=True) rejected it

recovery.implemented: strict base64 decoder strips ASCII whitespace; no-scan MASTER-first queue refresh implemented

follow_up_v0_2_54.confirmed_root_cause: fetch_master_snapshot stored SHA-256 of raw GitHub JSON bytes, while validate_snapshot recomputed SHA-256 over sorted, indented canonical JSON; GUI direct loader exposed the commit without calling the cache snapshot validator, so GUI commit display did not prove engine snapshot validation.
follow_up_v0_2_54.fix: Use one canonical JSON digest for online and cached snapshots; detail digest and master-store validation issues; GUI and engine share fetch_master_snapshot validation.
follow_up_v0_2_54.refresh_ui_root_cause: The success callback set its message and immediately called reload(), which replaced the visible status with a new Git synchronization message.
follow_up_v0_2_54.fix_refresh: Persistent separate refresh result shows source count to active count, covered tasks, Git commit, elapsed time and BEZ RENDERU; unchanged counts include evidence-based explanation.
follow_up_v0_2_54.startup_recovery: If a valid saved review queue exists, restore it and refresh Git Master without a new full scan; first/invalid/missing queue still runs the scan.
follow_up_v0_2_54.task_statuses: A derived per-review-ID status report is generated without changing evidence-hashed queue item bodies; no identity approvals are inferred.
